questions.q: how do i ask govt office why my file not moving
questions.note: Partial: the corpus covers how to file/write an RTI (rti-001 application text, rti-000 central ministries via portal, rti-010 Submit Request tab) but nothing specifically on asking why a file is stuck.

questions.q: rti fee kitna i mean how much is it 10rs
questions.note: No passage states the fee amount (Rs 10); rti-002 covers payment modes and BPL waiver but only says 'prescribed RTI fee' without the figure.

questions.q: paid online money gone but no confirmaton mail
questions.note: rti-012 is the exact money-debited-no-registration case (Payment Reconciliation, 24-48h, helpline email); rti-018 adds the bank-refund route past 48h; rti-003 explains the confirmation is the registration number.

questions.q: sent rti by post 40 days back no responce
questions.note: 30 days lapsed without reply -> first appeal (rti-013); online appeal only against online applications, so a postal applicant appeals physically (rti-014); rti-023 covers CPIO-lodged manual apps getting a reg number usable for appeal; rti-006 the appeal mechanics.

questions.q: they replied but didnt answer my actual questin what next
questions.note: Partial: no passage addresses appeals against incomplete/unsatisfactory replies; rti-006 gives the first-appeal mechanism (Submit First Appeal, reg no + email), which is the actual next step.

questions.q: first appeal also ignored where to go now
questions.note: Corpus has no second-appeal/CIC content; 'Complaint & Second Appeal to CIC' appears only as a navigation-link string inside rti-025's footer text, which is not an answer.

questions.q: which commision to complain state or central confused
questions.note: Nothing on Information Commission jurisdiction - state (SIC) vs central (CIC) is never explained in the corpus.

questions.q: i addressed it to wrong dept will they send it to right one
questions.note: rti-004 answers directly: Nodal Officer transfers under sec 6(3) to the right central authority, but state-authority applications are returned without refund.

questions.q: im bpl do i pay anything for rti
questions.note: rti-002 states no RTI fee for below-poverty-line applicants per RTI Rules 2012, and that a copy of the BPL certificate must be attached.

questions.q: they want extra money for copies is that allowed
questions.note: rti-005 covers exactly this: CPIO may intimate additional fee representing the cost, notified via View Status/SMS/email and payable online through Make Payment.

questions.q: can i get copy of my exam answer sheet thru rti
questions.note: Nothing on exam answer sheets, what records can be sought, or the sec 8 disclosure exemptions - the corpus cannot ground a yes/no.

questions.q: what to write in rti letter dont know format
questions.note: rti-001 is the writing-the-application passage: text in the prescribed column of the request form, 3000-character limit, longer text as PDF attachment.

questions.q: pio name not on website who do i address
questions.note: Partial: rti-003 says the online application reaches the department's Nodal Officer (not the CPIO) who forwards it - so no PIO name is needed on the portal; nothing covers postal addressing or finding PIO names.

questions.q: can i file rti for my village panchayat spending
questions.note: Panchayat is a state/local authority: portal is central-govt only (rti-022), such applications are returned without refund (rti-004), portal scope is central ministries (rti-000); nothing on panchayat spending records specifically.

questions.q: rti rejected saying personal info but its about me only
questions.note: No passage covers rejection grounds, the sec 8(1)(j) personal-information exemption, or appealing a rejected RTI; rti-025 is only about OTP protection of personal data.

questions.q: police verfication still pending after 1 month what do
questions.note: passport-026 is the pending-PV remedy (visit the Passport Office concerned); passport-029 points to the citizen charter for how long pre/post-PV takes.

questions.q: cop never came but status says sent to police
questions.note: No per-status explanation in the corpus; the pending-PV remedy applies - visit the Passport Office (passport-026), timelines via citizen charter (passport-029).

questions.q: got adverse report dont know why i have no case
questions.note: passport-045: contact the Passport Office to learn the reason, request re-verification after clarification, clear report needed before the passport is issued.

questions.q: police said not found at address i was at work
questions.note: Partial: 'not found' reports are not covered specifically; passport-045 gives the applicable remedy - contact PO for the reason, re-verification can be requested, clear report needed.

questions.q: my kid 3 yrs old need police check for passport
questions.note: passport-030: generally no PV for minors up to 18 when a parent holds a valid passport with the child's name and Annexure-D consent; final call rests with the Passport Office.

questions.q: dad is 68 renewing passport police will come?
questions.note: passport-033 (65-year-old case): PV cannot be skipped for senior citizens; Tatkaal with documents gets post-PV basis. Nothing renewal-specific in the corpus.

questions.q: shifted to new flat after applying now what
questions.note: Partial: no passage covers address change after applying; passport-037 (PV done at both permanent and present address) and passport-047 (present-address proof, all last-year addresses furnished) are the nearest information.

questions.q: what documents to show when police come home
questions.note: Partial: no passage lists what to show the visiting police; passport-047 states address proof of the present address is what PV requires and all last-year addresses must be furnished.

questions.q: can police verification happen thru app no visit
questions.note: Partial: no app/online PV option exists in the corpus; passport-028 lists only the two physical modes (pre- and post-issuance PV), from which the negative answer follows.

questions.q: how long police verification take usually
questions.note: passport-029 is the processing-time passage (refers to the citizen charter); passport-026 the escalation if it drags on (visit the Passport Office).

questions.q: tatkal passport police check before or after
questions.note: passport-046 answers directly: under Tatkaal PV is not done before issuance, it is on post-PV basis; passport-028 lists the modes and names the Tatkaal exception.

questions.q: police asking money to clear my report
questions.note: No anti-bribery content in the corpus; passport-045 gives the legitimate clearing path - contact the Passport Office for the reason, re-verification, clear report needed (not payment).

questions.q: old fir closed will it block my passport
questions.note: Partial: closed/old FIRs are never covered; passport-042 (pending criminal case -> court permission, short-validity passport) and passport-043 (conviction -> possible with approval) are the nearest criminal-record passages.

questions.q: living on rent no agreement can police verify
questions.note: Partial: nothing on renting without an agreement or acceptable alternative address proofs; passport-047 only states address proof of the present address is required and all residences of the last year must be furnished for PV.

questions.q: passport came but verification shows pending is ok?
questions.note: passport-028 defines the post-PV mode (verification after issuance is a normal mode) and passport-046 the Tatkaal case; the corpus never says outright to check which PV mode your file has.

questions.q: cant afford lawyer can govt give one free
questions.note: legal-aid-049 states free legal services in civil and criminal matters for people who cannot afford a lawyer; legal-aid-060/061 give the Section 12 eligibility and the genuine-case condition.

questions.q: who all can get free legal help
questions.note: legal-aid-060 lists the full Section 12 eligibility categories; legal-aid-061 adds income amounts, state-specific additions and the sec 13 genuine-case condition.

questions.q: how to apply free lawyer in my district
questions.note: legal-aid-055 is the apply-where/how passage (DLSA front office in the district court, LSMS portal, post, email); legal-aid-056 the plain-paper/oral/email options; legal-aid-102 what happens after submitting.

questions.q: husband harrasing me no money for case
questions.note: legal-aid-094 is the domestic-violence passage (free legal aid application, compensation scheme, counselling, NGO/Women Cell referrals); legal-aid-062 women entitled irrespective of income; legal-aid-092 matrimonial cases covered.

questions.q: my son is minor police took him need lawyer
questions.note: legal-aid-065: a child in conflict with law is entitled to free legal aid; legal-aid-073 aid is available at production/remand hearings; legal-aid-064 a child applies through parents/guardian; legal-aid-060 the Section 12 custody categories.

questions.q: brother in jail long time no bail no lawyer
questions.note: legal-aid-082: people in custody get aid irrespective of means; legal-aid-085: aid to challenge bail rejection; legal-aid-070 and legal-aid-072 confirm custody/arrest entitlements.

questions.q: what is lok adalat can my case go there
questions.note: legal-aid-111 defines Lok Adalat; legal-aid-112 covers which cases qualify (civil + compoundable criminal, pre-litigation or court referral) and what cannot go; legal-aid-113 the benefits.

questions.q: bank loan fight settle without court possible
questions.note: legal-aid-112: civil cases can go to Lok Adalat even pre-litigation (i.e. without filing in court); legal-aid-111 definition; legal-aid-128 mediation for civil disputes; legal-aid-113 benefits. Corpus never says whether bank loans qualify as Public Utility Services for Permanent Lok Adalat.

questions.q: do i need income proof for free lawyer
questions.note: legal-aid-076: a sworn income affidavit is generally sufficient proof (sec 13(2)); legal-aid-078: the affidavit must accompany the application when claiming on income grounds; legal-aid-077: other Section 12 categories skip the income test.

questions.q: is free legal aid only for criminal case or civil also
questions.note: legal-aid-091 answers directly: civil as well as criminal, plus quasi-criminal and tribunals; legal-aid-049: free services in civil and criminal matters; legal-aid-061: no bar on case type if Section 12 eligibility is met.

questions.q: labour not paid salary can i get free help
questions.note: Partial: unpaid-salary recovery is not addressed specifically; legal-aid-069 (industrial workman entitled), legal-aid-098 (worker/termination assistance + unorganised workers scheme) and legal-aid-060 (Section 12 list) are the nearest.

questions.q: im sc can i get free advocate
questions.note: legal-aid-081: SC/ST get aid with no income test, need a caste certificate; legal-aid-099 confirms entitlement and where to approach; legal-aid-060 lists SC/ST in Section 12.

questions.q: where is dlsa office how to contact
questions.note: legal-aid-055: DLSA sits in the district court premises with a front office, plus portal/post/email options; legal-aid-054: 15100 helpline; legal-aid-045 what/where a DLSA is. No per-office phone numbers in the corpus.

questions.q: free lawyer not coming to hearings what to do
questions.note: Partial: nothing on assigned lawyers missing hearings; legal-aid-108 gives the complaint escalation path (Member Secretary of SLSA/NALSA depending on the institution complained against).

questions.q: land dispute with relatives free legal help avalable
questions.note: legal-aid-095 covers land/property disputes via SLSA/DLSA if eligible (ADR encouraged); legal-aid-091 confirms civil+criminal scope; legal-aid-061 says no bar on case type if Section 12 eligibility is met.
